faqs.q: What is the OTECO hub-and-clamp connector?
faqs.a: The OTECO Connector is a hub-and-clamp connector that does the job of a high-pressure flanged joint in less space and weight. Two hubs take the place of the flanges, a clamp takes the place of the flange bolts, and a seal ring is the gasket. Standard sizes are 1" to 12", with heavy-duty sizes B to F.

faqs.q: How are OTECO connector sizes and heavy-duty sizes B to F designated?
faqs.a: Standard connectors are sized from 1" to 12", and the heavy-duty connectors are designated by letter, B to F. Because every connector is quoted to order, send the size or hub designation, the pressure and temperature, the service, the hub end preparation and the materials, and we return Oteco's offer.

faqs.q: Is the OTECO connector interchangeable with Grayloc clamp connectors?
faqs.a: Oteco states that the OTECO Connector is interchangeable with Grayloc clamp connectors. Grayloc is a trademark of its owner, and Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with it. Confirm the hub designation, size and pressure rating on your existing connection before ordering, and we check it against Oteco's offer.

faqs.q: What sizes does the OTECO hub-and-clamp connector come in?
faqs.a: Standard sizes run from 1" to 12", and heavy-duty sizes are B to F. Hubs are supplied in weld or machined form, with a clamp and a seal ring. There is no fixed part-number list because the connector is quoted to order against your size, pressure and hub end preparation.

faqs.q: What do I send to get an OTECO connector quoted?
faqs.a: Send the size or hub designation, the pressure and temperature, the service, the hub end preparation and the materials. With those we return Oteco's offer. If you are replacing an existing connector, the nameplate or hub markings help us match the size and series.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature does an OTECO connector handle?
faqs.a: Oteco does not publish one rating, because the connector is made to order for the pressure and temperature you specify. It is used where conditions are hard on a flange: corrosive or hazardous fluids, high temperatures and cryogenic service. Give us the pressure and temperature and we confirm the connector with Oteco before quoting.

faqs.q: What materials are OTECO connectors machined from?
faqs.a: The components are machined from certifiable materials, for standard and sour gas service. The materials are chosen to order against your fluid and temperature, so state the service and the material you need. Send the fluid, the pressure and the temperature when you request a quotation.

faqs.q: What parts make up an OTECO hub-and-clamp joint?
faqs.a: A joint has two hubs, a clamp and a seal ring: the hubs replace the flanges, the clamp replaces the flange bolts, and the seal ring replaces the gasket. Hubs are weld or machined. Order the seal ring with the connector, because it is replaced whenever the joint is opened.

faqs.q: How is an OTECO connector made up and broken out?
faqs.a: The connector is much smaller and lighter than an equivalent flanged connection and quicker to make up and break out, since one clamp replaces a ring of flange bolts. Follow the maker's make-up instructions supplied with the offer. Fit a new seal ring each time the joint is opened.

faqs.q: Where is an OTECO hub-and-clamp connector used?
faqs.a: It is used in place of a high-pressure flanged joint where space and weight matter, or where conditions are hard on a flange: corrosive or hazardous fluids, high temperatures and cryogenic service. See the [flow iron fittings](/c/flow-iron-fittings-suppliers-uae) shelf and the guide to [flow iron](/blog/flow-iron-explained) for the wider context.

faqs.q: Who makes the OTECO hub-and-clamp connector?
faqs.a: Oteco Inc. makes it in Houston, Texas, USA, so the country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East. For related Oteco fittings see the [flow iron fittings](/c/flow-iron-fittings-suppliers-uae) shelf.

faqs.q: How do I order an OTECO hub-and-clamp connector?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times; the OTECO Connector itself is made to order, so we quote it from Oteco's offer. To [request a quotation](/contact), send the size or hub designation, pressure, temperature, service, hub end preparation and materials.
